items.title: 3 Stocks Investors Are Watching For Corporate Governance And Litigation Demand
items.summary: Nvidia’s boardroom drama, with Jensen Huang’s reinstatement and a growing tangle of lawsuits and probes, has put corporate governance, legal risk and reputation back in the spotlight for investors. When headline risk explodes at a giant like Nvidia, capital often starts hunting for businesses that help boards, insurers and law firms make sense of the fallout. This article walks through 3 stocks exposed to that story, and explains how the same headlines can mean very different things for each...
